### Chesterfield County

- **Type:** County
- **Status:** 🟢 Active
- **Date enacted:** June 1, 2026 (County Council third reading and public hearing, adopting Ordinance 25-26-23)
- **Normalized date:** `2026-06-01` (exact)
- **Duration:** Until January 1, 2028, or until the county adopts regulations for data center/data processing/cryptocurrency mining uses, whichever occurs first
- **Current end date:** `—`
- **Sectors:** data center, cryptocurrency mining
- **Moratorium ID:** `sc-chesterfield-county-2026`
- **Legal basis:** Ordinance 25-26-23 (Chesterfield County Council)
- **What prompted it:** Immediately stops acceptance, review, or action on zoning approvals, construction permits, site plans, and other county approvals for data centers, data processing facilities, cryptocurrency mining operations, and related uses in unincorporated Chesterfield County; followed an emergency moratorium adopted April 6, 2026.
- **Affected projects:** —
- **Detailed status:** Active as of 2026-07-31; regular ordinance replacing an April 6, 2026 emergency moratorium, in effect until 2028-01-01 or earlier adoption of permanent regulations.
- **Outcome:** Adopted long-term temporary moratorium on data center and related approvals in unincorporated Chesterfield County.

### Colleton County

- **Type:** County
- **Status:** 🟢 Active
- **Date enacted:** July 6, 2026 (County Council third reading and enactment of Ordinance 26-O-04, effective immediately)
- **Normalized date:** `2026-07-06` (exact)
- **Duration:** Six months
- **Current end date:** `—`
- **Sectors:** data center
- **Moratorium ID:** `sc-colleton-county-2026`
- **Legal basis:** Ordinance 26-O-04 (Colleton County Council)
- **What prompted it:** Pauses consideration of special exceptions, conditional uses, and other land-use approvals for data centers while county staff and the Planning Commission study appropriate locations/conditions and prepare comprehensive-plan and code amendments; also holds received-but-unconsidered applications in abeyance.
- **Affected projects:** Unspecified data center project(s) subject to related Southern Environmental Law Center litigation, paused during the moratorium.
- **Detailed status:** Active as of 2026-07-31; the Southern Environmental Law Center agreed to pause related litigation for the moratorium period.
- **Outcome:** Adopted six-month moratorium on data center special exceptions/conditional uses.

### York County

- **Type:** County
- **Status:** 🟢 Active
- **Date enacted:** July 13, 2026 (County Council third reading and public hearing, effective immediately in unincorporated York County)
- **Normalized date:** `2026-07-13` (exact)
- **Duration:** Nine months
- **Current end date:** `—`
- **Sectors:** data center
- **Moratorium ID:** `sc-york-county-2026`
- **Legal basis:** York County Council moratorium ordinance on data centers; ordinance number not located in sources reviewed
- **What prompted it:** Restricts special-exception and conditional-use approvals, site-plan acceptance, and other land-use/development approvals for data centers in unincorporated York County while the county studies utility, water, noise, pollution, infrastructure, and nearby-property impacts.
- **Affected projects:** Existing vested projects, including approved QTS site plans, are exempt from the moratorium.
- **Detailed status:** Active as of 2026-07-31; may be extended by resolution if more study time is needed. Applies only in unincorporated areas; vested projects, including approved QTS site plans, are exempt.
- **Outcome:** Adopted nine-month moratorium on data center land-use approvals in unincorporated York County.
